headline: Nasdaq Falls To 25,968.07 From 26,058.7 As The VIX Rises To 19.78 From 18.99
narrative: The Nasdaq fell to 25,968.07 from 26,058.7, and the S&P 500 fell to 7,647.08 from 7,660.71, widening its loss to 1.42 percent from 1.24 percent. The VIX rose to 19.78 from 18.99. The equity pipe is the cash mark on listed stock prices, and the VIX pipe is the price of protection on those indexes, so stock prices were marked down while hedges were marked up.
author: jordan
